```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
```

## Load Data

Place the Kaggle CSV in `data_common/raw/kaggle/` first, then run this chunk.

```{r load}
path <- "../../../data_common/raw/kaggle/California_Fire_Incidents_2013-2019_raw.csv"
df <- read_csv(path)
glimpse(df)
```

```{r summary}
summary(df)
```

```{r missing}
df |>
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.)))) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "column", values_to = "missing") |>
  arrange(desc(missing))
```

## Clean Data

```{r clean}
df_clean <- df |>
  dplyr::select(
    -FuelType, -StructuresEvacuated, -PercentContained,
    -AirTankers, -Dozers, -Engines, -Helicopters, -CrewsInvolved,
    -Fatalities
  ) |>
  filter(year(Started) > 2000) |>
  filter(!is.na(AcresBurned), AcresBurned > 0)

glimpse(df_clean)
```

## Filter: Sierra Nevada 2013–2016, Assign Clusters

All 22 official Sierra Nevada counties, split by High Hazard Zone designation
from the Governor's Tree Mortality Task Force:
- Sequoia cluster (HHZ): southern and central Sierra, catastrophic collapse
- Plumas cluster (Non-HHZ): northern Sierra, elevated but buffered mortality

```{r filter}
hhz_counties <- c("Amador", "Calaveras", "El Dorado", "Fresno", "Kern",
                  "Madera", "Mariposa", "Placer", "Tulare", "Tuolumne")

non_hhz_counties <- c("Nevada", "Plumas", "Sierra")

all_sierra <- c(hhz_counties, non_hhz_counties)

sierra <- df_clean |>
  filter(
    str_detect(Counties, paste(all_sierra, collapse = "|")),
    between(ArchiveYear, 2013, 2016)
  ) |>
  mutate(cluster = case_when(
    str_detect(Counties, paste(hhz_counties,     collapse = "|")) ~ "Sequoia",
    str_detect(Counties, paste(non_hhz_counties, collapse = "|")) ~ "Plumas",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ))

nrow(sierra)
sierra |> count(cluster, ArchiveYear)
```

## Save Processed Data

```{r save}
out <- "../../data/processed/Sierra_Nevada_Fire_Incidents_2013-2016.csv"
write_csv(sierra, out)
message("Saved: data/processed/Sierra_Nevada_Fire_Incidents_2013-2016.csv")
```
